tips.text: Kill enemy Necramechs for matrices instead of waiting on bounty rewards; Tier 1 drops Orientation, Tier 2 Ballistics, Tier 3 Animus.
Bring Nekros with Desecrate, a drop booster and Resourceful Retriever; Desecrate works on Necramech drops.
Join public vault lobbies instead of going solo; solo stage 1, the residue and bait defense, is where people struggle.
Return to the Necralisk between vaults to re-accept bounties from Mother.
Bring Vauban with range and strength for the defense and toxicity stages.
Reach Ostron Rank 2 and fish some Orb Vallis cold weather Tink early; Fersteel Alloy and Tink Dissipator Coil need both.
Expect a long farm for a lackluster gun; most players call it worth it for Mastery, not for the weapon.
Buy the Damaged parts from Loid rather than waiting on the vault drops, which used to stall players for days.
